column1: # The {5,7,10} sweep diverged by instance: ntil-43 peaks at ~5 (t5~=t7, t10
# hurts), but ntil-45 (the hard, timeout-bound instance) improved strongly to
# t10 (+5 solves, PAR-2 452->368 vs t5) and had not peaked. Push higher on
# ntil-45 to find where it turns over. t10 is carried as the known-good
# anchor on a fresh seed block (801-1000), re-baselining t10 over 200
# independent seeds. randk stays at its default (1). (For ntil-43, higher
# randtour only hurts -- this sweep is really about ntil-45.)
